results.name: Lac de Saint-Ferréol
results.principal_activities: Swimming (supervised in summer), hiking the 4.5 km lakeside loop, fishing, picnicking, water sports, cycling the Canal du Midi greenway

results.name: Cirque de Gavarnie
results.principal_activities: Hiking to the cirque floor and its 422 m waterfall (highest in Europe), horse riding, canyoning, panoramic viewpoints

results.name: Pont d'Espagne & Lac de Gaube
results.attraction_type: Waterfalls, mountain lake & Pyrenees National Park
results.principal_activities: Hiking to Lac de Gaube with views of the Vignemale (3 298 m), waterfall viewing at Pont d'Espagne, cable-car ride, photography

results.name: Lac d'Oô
results.principal_activities: Hiking (moderate trail to the lake), waterfall viewing, mountain photography

results.name: Pic du Midi de Bigorre
results.principal_activities: Cable-car ascent to 2 877 m, 360° panorama of the Pyrenees chain, stargazing at the observatory, suspended sky-bridge walk

results.name: Gorges du Tarn
results.principal_activities: Canoeing/kayaking (13–21 km circuits), swimming in turquoise pools, cliff-side hiking, wildlife watching (vultures, beavers)

results.name: Gorges de l'Aveyron
results.principal_activities: Canoeing, rock climbing, hiking, swimming in the Aveyron river

results.name: Massif du Néouvielle
results.principal_activities: Hiking among high-altitude lakes (Lac d'Aubert, Lac d'Aumar), wildlife observation, mountain photography
